claim_boundary.units: All numeric fields are DIMENSIONLESS_SYMBOLIC. Impedance and capacity are NOT ohms or farads; energy is NOT joules. Any physical unit binding requires a new version and a PHYSICAL claim split. Integers anywhere in a numeric field must lie within +-(2**53-1) (D6).
claim_boundary.fail_closed_scope: No uncaught exception and no out-of-domain acceptance for JSON-like inputs. Not claimed: Python objects with custom __eq__/__hash__/__float__, recursion-depth attacks, memory exhaustion.

key_convention.rule: Canonical record keys are the field LABELS (e.g. INTERNAL_HARMONY), never the short symbols.
key_convention.reason: Short symbols collide with established notation: H_i vs H-Space, Re_i vs Reynolds number (NS channel), E_i vs E_links_i / electric field, O_i vs oxygen, Z_i vs atomic number, C_i vs color. Author symbols are kept for display only and are not renamed.

record_semantics: A DNA17 record is a typed RECORD (product type), not a vector in R^17. No norm, distance, sum or scalar multiple of whole records is defined in V0.1.

fields.memory_rule: D7: append-only under a protected transition (existing entries and Chemical_Ref fixed; Color_Projection derived and free); every change reported

fields.domain: Chemical_Ref non-empty string or null; Spectral_Signature finite >= 0; r,g,b in [0,1]
fields.note: Not linked to measured spectra in V0.1.
fields.memory_rule: D7: append-only under a protected transition (existing entries and Chemical_Ref fixed; Color_Projection derived and free); every change reported

fields.domain: {3, 5}; 11 reserved (E_RESERVED_PROFILE) for a separately versioned EIT_11D profile

fields.note: Encodes the author's cycle (birth, life, death, new cycle) as phase within cycle plus number of completed cycles.

fields.domain: references must resolve to voxels in the same network; no self-reference; no duplicates

fields.proposed_type: object{source: string, confidence: number, source_sha256?: hex64}
fields.rule: Never modified by tau. Only an explicit review action may change it.

fields.proposed_type: object{t: number, neighbors: array<voxel_id>, links: array<{target: voxel_id, weight: number}>, tau: {operator_id: string, version: string, memory_preserving: boolean}}
fields.domain: neighbors resolve, unique, no self; every link target is a neighbor; weight finite >= 0; all voxels in one snapshot share the same t; at most one link per target; identifiers without control characters or edge whitespace
fields.tau_signature: tau_i : V_i(t) x {V_j(t) : j in N_i(t)} -> V_i(t + dt)
fields.note: tau is a REFERENCE to a registered operator, never embedded executable code. Not reduced to static RELATIONS.

fields.proposed_type: object{voxel_id: string, payload: string, payload_sha256: hex64}
fields.domain: voxel_id non-empty, unique in network; payload_sha256 must equal SHA-256 of UTF-8 payload (script-computed, never hand-typed); payload is free text, strict UTF-8

invariants.INV_1_KEYS: Record has exactly the 17 keys; unknown keys rejected (fail-closed).
invariants.INV_3_REFS: All neighbor, link and bio-holographic references resolve.
invariants.INV_4_TIME: All T_i in one snapshot share the same t.
invariants.INV_6_IDENTITY_STABLE: Across any transition: voxel_id and VOXEL_UNIT never change; voxels are not silently added or removed.
invariants.INV_7_P_M: P_M(G(t+1)) = P_M(G(t)) under a protected transition: INFORMATION_IDENTITY unchanged (C6, D5) and spectral history append-only (D7).
invariants.INV_8_PROVENANCE: PROVENANCE_CONFIDENCE unchanged across a tau transition.
invariants.P_T_NOTE: Topological shape (neighbors, links) MAY change; no invariant imposed on P_T in V0.1.
invariants.INV_10_TAU_SEMANTICS: tau declared at t(before) produced t(after); declaration changes reported as W_TAU_DECLARATION_CHANGED (C6).
invariants.INV_11_NOTHING_SILENT: Every identity rewrite or spectral change is either an error or a warning.

envelope.rule: D1: the schema version lives in the snapshot envelope; unknown versions are rejected. VOXEL_UNIT stays literal 1.
